Cher's Top 10 Movie Roles That Will Make You Fall in Love (Again)

20 May 2024 · RewindZone Archive

Cher's enduring legacy as a multi-talented entertainer has been solidified by her remarkable performances on the screen. From comedic roles that showcased her impeccable timing to heart-wrenching dramas that tugged at the heartstrings, Cher's acting prowess has captivated audiences for decades. Join us as we celebrate the iconic Goddess of Pop's most unforgettable and critically acclaimed film roles, each a testament to her versatility and undeniable charisma.

10. Stuck on You (2003)

Conjoined twins Bob and Walt Tenor move to Los Angeles so Walt can pursue his dream of becoming an actor. Cher's role adds a delightful touch to this quirky comedy, as she charms audiences with her wit and charisma. Her performance stands out for its comedic timing and memorable presence, earning a spot on our ranking.

9. If These Walls Could Talk (1996)

Advertisement

This made-for-TV drama explores the issue of abortion through three distinct time periods. Cher's segment, directed by herself and Nancy Savoca, is a poignant portrayal of a doctor providing illegal abortions in the 1970s. Cher's directorial debut showcases her versatility and depth as an actress, earning recognition for her powerful portrayal and earning a place on our list.

8. Suspect (1987)

Cher stars as Kathleen Riley, a public defender assigned to defend a homeless man accused of murder. Her riveting performance adds depth and complexity to this gripping courtroom drama, captivating audiences with her portrayal of determination and resilience. Cher's portrayal of Kathleen Riley showcases her acting prowess and earns her a spot on our ranking.

7. Mermaids (1990)

Cher plays Rachel Flax, a free-spirited single mother raising her two daughters in the 1960s. Her performance adds heart and humour to this endearing coming-of-age story as she navigates the ups and downs of motherhood with authenticity and relatability. Cher's portrayal of Rachel Flax resonates with audiences, earning her recognition for her memorable performance.

6. The Witches of Eastwick (1987)

Cher stars alongside Susan Sarandon and Michelle Pfeiffer as one of three women who discover their hidden powers when a mysterious man arrives in their small town. Cher's portrayal of a woman discovering her inner strength adds depth and intrigue to this enchanting tale, captivating audiences with her mesmerizing performance. Her portrayal stands out for its magical finesse and earns her a place on our ranking.

5. Burlesque (2010)

Advertisement

Cher stars as Tess, the owner of a struggling burlesque club in Los Angeles. Her mentorship of a small-town girl seeking stardom adds emotional depth and resonance to this empowering musical drama. Cher's portrayal of Tess showcases her resilience and determination, earning her recognition for her inspiring performance and securing a spot on our list.

4. Come Back to the Five and Dime, Jimmy Dean, Jimmy Dean (1982)

Directed by Robert Altman, this drama explores the lives of a group of women who reunite at a small-town Texas diner to commemorate the anniversary of their involvement with a James Dean fan club. Cher's authentic portrayal of female friendship and resilience adds depth and authenticity to this poignant story, earning her recognition for her compelling performance and securing a spot on our ranking.

3. Silkwood (1983)

Based on a true story, Cher portrays Dolly Pelliker, a close friend of Karen Silkwood, who becomes an activist after uncovering unsafe working conditions at a plutonium processing plant. Cher's powerful performance as an activist deeply moves viewers, stirring emotions and igniting a sense of social awareness. Her portrayal stands out for its raw emotion and earns her recognition for her compelling performance, securing a spot on our list.

2. Moonstruck (1987)

Cher stars as Loretta Castorini, a Brooklyn widow who unexpectedly falls in love with her fiancé's estranged brother. Her performance in this romantic comedy is a perfect blend of humour, warmth, and vulnerability, captivating audiences with her unforgettable portrayal. Cher's chemistry with Nicolas Cage in "Moonstruck" was one of the film's standout features. Despite their characters' unconventional relationship as future in-laws, Cher and Cage shared an undeniable on-screen chemistry that added depth and authenticity to their interactions. Their unlikely connection, filled with passion, humour, and tenderness, contributed to the film's charm and appeal, earning praise from audiences and critics alike. Their dynamic performances and magnetic chemistry were a key factor in making "Moonstruck" a beloved classic.

1.Mask (1985)

Mask marked a significant turning point in Cher's acting career, as it provided her with a role that perfectly blended her transformative acting ambitions with her naturally larger-than-life persona. In this film, Cher not only showcased her exceptional talent as an actress but also brought a depth and authenticity to her performance that resonated with audiences on a profound level. As Rusty Dennis's mother, Cher found a character that allowed her to explore the complexities of motherhood, love, and resilience in a way that felt both genuine and deeply impactful. It was a role that truly allowed Cher to shine and cemented her status as a powerhouse performer in Hollywood.

"Looking back, it's not hard to imagine that had the film been released a decade later, Cher's performance could have easily garnered her an Academy Award. Its poignant portrayal of maternal love and resilience may have been ahead of its time, but its impact remains timeless."

Additionally, during its release, 'Mask' touched the hearts of many viewers who found solace and inspiration in Cher's portrayal of Rusty Dennis's mother. Her unwavering love, support, and fierce advocacy for her son resonated deeply with audiences, many of whom longed for a mother figure like her. Cher's portrayal served as a beacon of hope and a reminder of the enduring power of maternal love and resilience.

Cher's journey in Hollywood has been nothing short of legendary, filled with an array of roles that have cemented her status as a true acting powerhouse. From the quirky comedies that showcased her impeccable timing to the heart-wrenching dramas that left audiences in awe, Cher's performances have transcended the boundaries of the silver screen!
